escenas.texto: Which was the most liked video in Oceania this week? Here is the podium. Watch until the end.
In third place, Great to see people learning about Australia …, by Toni and Ryan, with over 250 thousand likes.
In second place, In This World RUMORS Become TRUE., by Bloxy Productions, with over 325 thousand likes.
And number one: I think we're seeing a glimpse of future Ben..., by Viva La Dirt League, with over 347 thousand likes.
The full countdown, from ten to one, is already on the channel. Find it in the description. Hashtag Top 10 RS.
